maxLength: 30
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must
            be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned
            lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date. The stored value is returned on read.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even if another owner already
            has the same last name and address (same household). Write-only flag
            used only on create; it is never stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Franklin, George'
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'G.F.'
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3
                is the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN
                is a global 4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned at creation.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'SMI-0007'
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registration date's year.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier assigned when an owner is created
                with 'sharesHousehold' true and joins an existing household
                (another owner with the same last name and address). All owners
                in the same household share the same value.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively). Assigned at creation and
                returned on read.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 1
            membershipTier:
              title: Membership tier
              description: >-
                The owner's derived membership tier. 'SILVER' when the owner has
                no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0) and an email address is
                present, otherwise 'BRONZE'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'SILVER'
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's region, derived from the city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC,
                Brisbane -> QLD). 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'NSW'
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the time this owner was created, more than 80
                owners had already been created for the current day; otherwise
                false. Assigned at creation and returned on read.
              type: boolean

## Summary

I implemented the GOLD membership tier rule: an owner's tier becomes `GOLD` when their household (owners sharing the same `householdId`) has 3 or more members, otherwise the existing SILVER/BRONZE rules apply.

Changes, following the existing Spring/MapStruct conventions:

1. **`ClinicService` / `ClinicServiceImpl`** — added `countHouseholdMembers(String householdId)`, a read-only method that counts owners sharing a given non-null `householdId` (returns 0 for null), mirroring the existing `findAll()`-iteration style used by `assignHousehold`/`isHouseholdInUse`.

2. **`Owner`** — added a `@Transient` `householdMemberCount` field (with accessors). It's not persisted, since household size can change over time; it carries the freshly-counted size into the DTO mapping, alongside the already-derived fields like `namesakeCount`.

3. **`OwnerMapper.toMembershipTier`** — now returns `GOLD` first when `householdMemberCount >= 3`, then falls through to the unchanged SILVER/BRONZE logic.

4. **`OwnerRestControllerV1`** — populates `householdMemberCount` (via the new service method) before mapping to the DTO in both `addOwner` (after save, so the count reflects the state "after this create") and `getOwner`, so the tier is correct on both the create response and subsequent reads.

The new acceptance test (`coreGoldForThreeMemberHousehold`) and the full suite pass.
